cases.description: Should trigger: team design from a project spec
cases.input: We're building an AI news pipeline that researches, writes, and publishes articles. Design a team of Hermes bots for it.
cases.expect: Designs a specialist bot team with role assignment, SOUL.md, model tiering, MCP wiring, and group chat setup
assertions: Maps each pipeline phase to a bot role
Assigns cheap models (DeepSeek V4 Flash) to mechanical phases and expensive models to deep-reasoning phases
Specifies SOUL.md sections and config.yaml per bot
Wires MeMex Zero RAG and HermesVault via inherit_mcp_toolsets: true
Creates a group chat directory with README roster

cases.description: Should trigger: expanding an existing fleet
cases.input: Add a UX/Design bot to our existing team and wire it into the group chat.
cases.expect: Adds one specialist UX/Design bot following the team design workflow
assertions: Assigns a creative/expensive model to the UX role
Disables Telegram for the team bot
Adds the bot to the group chat roster

cases.description: Should trigger: migrating an OpenClaw workflow to Hermes Bot Mode
cases.input: Migrate our OpenClaw news workflow to Hermes Bot Mode as a team of specialist bots.
cases.expect: Produces a Hermes bot team design mirroring the OpenClaw pipeline phases
assertions: Identifies pipeline phases and handoffs from the existing workflow
Maps each phase to a bot with a role and model tier
Sets up group chat and MCP inheritance

cases.description: Not trigger: single-bot task with no team or fleet context
cases.input: Fix the bug in our checkout page's payment handling.
cases.expect: Does not invoke team design workflow

cases.description: Not trigger: asking about model capabilities, not designing a team
cases.input: Which model is best for creative writing tasks?
cases.expect: Answers the model question without designing a bot team
assertions: No role assignment or profile scaffolding
